# Survey catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_catalog.py from catalog/surveys.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

All 49 military anthropometric surveys, grouped by region. Links marked DTIC use the
`apps.dtic.mil/sti/tr/pdf/<ACC>.pdf` or `apps.dtic.mil/sti/pdfs/<ACC>.pdf` form; both work.
See [`catalog/link_status.csv`](catalog/link_status.csv) for the latest automated link check.

Legend — **Data**: `public` (downloadable, copy in `data/`), `not public`, `commercial`, `restricted`, `n/a` (summary statistics only).
**Verification**: `verified` (report title page seen), `partly verified`, `not verified` (best available citation only).
